title: i think... because...
subtitle: an opinion with a reason is easy to say

steps.text: an opinion doesn't have to be big or right. it's just what you think, and "because" lets people see why.

steps.prompt: someone asks which movie to watch. try each answer on:
options: i think the comedy, because i could use a laugh tonight.
steps.question: which one would you say most days?
steps.reply: all of them are real answers. the last one just gives people a little more of you.

steps.prompt: low stakes. is breakfast for dinner better than breakfast?

parts.label: because
parts.placeholder: e.g. pancakes at night feel like a treat
ideas: pancakes at night feel like a treat.
morning food belongs in the morning.
good food is good any time.

steps.reply: that's an opinion. you just had one.

steps.prompt: one more. does a messy room bother you?

parts.label: because
parts.placeholder: e.g. a clear space helps me think
ideas: a clear space helps me think.
a little mess feels lived in.
it depends how my head feels.

steps.reply: saved. you can change your mind anytime.

steps.prompt: one small thing for today, if you want:
options: next time someone asks what you'd prefer, give one small opinion with a "because."
notice one thing you have an opinion about today, even silently.

steps.text: that's "i think... because..." your thoughts are worth saying out loud.

grounding.idea: a clearer sense of who you are is linked to wellbeing
